title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
provenance: Reported by kinging742 (highball-db#595, 2026-10-20), Apple M4, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT environment, msync, AVX advertised, rated 4 of 5 after 78 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on the default engine with DXMT over a 78-minute session, with one annoyance: the mouse cursor shows up when the view is turned toward a corner of the screen. The reporter sees the same in other first-person games such as Poppy Playtime, and not in native Mac games. The bottle had been set up for Counter-Strike 2, whose dxvk.conf section covers csgo.exe alone, so none of it reaches this game. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The mouse cursor appears and moves around when the view is turned toward a corner of the screen (reported on an M4, macOS 27.2, DXMT, engine r28)
knownIssues.cause: not investigated. The reporter sees it in other first-person games under Highball too, so it is likely Wine's mouse handling on macOS rather than this game
